answer: Commit a hash of the work, reveal it one epoch later, and let the receipt expire unless fresh work renews it. A duplicate is caught by replaying the reveal against the committed hash, not by matching names, so renaming a clone buys nothing. Each receipt is an island of proof tied to one address; a gale of submissions from one operator leaves a trail of identical hashes. An opal bond covers the reveal window, forfeited on a double reveal.
